notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only (curl_cffi impersonate chrome124 + requests), no block encountered; robots.txt (ikea.com) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and only blocks specific query-param/search-result/fragment paths, none of which were used. TREE: built via direct HTTP fetch of each category page's server-rendered HTML, parsing the 'hnf-inpage-nav' in-page-navigation carousel (the site's own sub-category tile strip) to get each node's true direct children (cross-checked against the embedded hierarchyObjs JSON and data-tracking-label breadcrumb attributes to avoid picking up the sitewide footer/cross-sell links that also litter each page). Roots crawled: Home textiles & rugs (tl001), Window treatments (tl002), Home storage & organisation (st007), Storage furniture (st001), Food storage & organisation (15937, filed under Kitchenware & tableware but storage-relevant), Laundry & cleaning (lc001, storage-relevant subset only), Bathroom furniture & storage (ba001, storage-relevant subset only). QTY: obtained via IKEA's own internal listing/search API (POST https://sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/gb/en/search?c=listaf&v=20250507, searchParameters={input:<categoryId>, type:CATEGORY}) discovered via captured network traffic on a rendered category page; called directly over HTTP (no browser) with a window size larger than the returned item count to guarantee the true total (Wardrobes required window=600 since the default 300 was hit exactly, i.e. truncated at 300->516 confirmed at 600). This is the exact same total the site itself renders on each category page. EXCLUDED: Clothing & accessories (42925, apparel), Curtain rods & rails (18891, hardware), Sewing accessories (14350, notions/tools not fabric product), Window films & accessories (700628, adhesive film not textile), Venetian blinds (700599, slat blinds - not fabric/textile), Anti-slip rug underlays (10699, rubber/PVC grip accessory not a rug/textile itself), named IKEA product systems/series used as cross-cutting collection hubs rather than standard taxonomy (PAX, KALLAX, BILLY, IVAR, BROR, OMAR, TROFAST, SMASTAD, BOAXEL/JONAXEL, ENHET laundry combos, LASTARE combinations, storage-solution-systems-46052) per the View All/Collections exclusion rule, Cable management & accessories (16195, electronics not storage), Waste bins & recycling/sorting bags branch (16213/34470/16215/48940/16214 - waste disposal, not organisational storage of belongings), plain Hangers (20618, not a storage container/organizer), Noticeboards (10574, not storage), Moving supplies (46078, packing/shipping materials not home storage), personal-carry Bags (shopping/tote 16295, backpacks 27821, travel accessories 16255, cool bags 46082 - fashion/travel carrying items excluded per storage.md Sec.6, only Bag organisers 47441 kept), Bedside tables & Dressing tables (20656/20657, surface-furniture not storage-primary), TV & media furniture (10475), Sideboards/buffets/console tables (30454, superseded by the narrower Sideboards & buffets 10412 which excludes console tables), Room dividers (46080), Hallway furniture sets (700411, mixed furniture set), most of Bathroom furniture & storage (ranges/vanities/mirrors/lighting/countertops/sinks/taps/showers/stools-benches/shelves-towel-rails - fixtures or non-storage furniture), most of Laundry & cleaning (waste bins, laundry/cleaning/dishwashing accessories, clothes drying racks, ironing boards, washing machines - not storage), 11 Wardrobe style/construction sub-variants (solitaire/fitted/hinged/sliding/open/corner/sloped-ceiling/reach-in/walk-in/mirrored/hallway) and 3 wardrobe accessory pages (shelving/lighting/sliding-doors) - rolled up into the single 'Wardrobes' row per the worker brief's efficiency allowance for very deep trees, since all 11 are the same product (a wardrobe) differing only by door/installation style, not by product type; similarly IVAR/BROR/OMAR garage-storage systems collapsed, keeping only the non-series 'Complete wall shelves' leaf. Bookcases (10382) and Sideboards & buffets/Display cabinets (10412/10410) kept as Storage (not Furniture) because IKEA's own navigation files them under the 'Storage furniture' > 'Bookcases & shelving units' / 'Cabinets & cupboards' hubs rather than under any of the site's separate furniture hubs (Tables & chairs, Living room seating, Office furniture, Beds & mattresses) - per storage.md Sec.21/27 'if the website explicitly places the product inside a Storage/Organization category, prefer Storage'. Duplicate cross-linked nodes (same category ID reachable from more than one menu path, e.g. Blankets & throws / Cushions & cushion covers appearing both at the Home textiles top level and inside Bedding; Storage boxes & baskets appearing under both Home storage and Decoration; Children's chest of drawers under both Chest of drawers group and Children's storage group) were each recorded exactly once under their single most specific/primary parent, never duplicated.
